d535a0dbfe40.curator_note: A dedicated day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set at Grand Park, not a shared festival stage — genuinely the better way to catch her than the HARD Summer slot the same month. Extended techno-into-acid-into-trance from a real headliner in a proper Factory 93 room.
d535a0dbfe40.description: Factory 93 presents a solo, day-to-dusk Amelie Lens set (techno, acid, trance) at Grand Park Block 2, DTLA.

edab80bd44cb.curator_note: Overmono is a tracked name and this is a proper club date, not a festival slot — the Gawsworth brothers' rave-nostalgic breaks-and-melody sound (Fabric, Warp) translates well to the Palladium's room, with a dedicated Vinyl Room opening early at 6:30.
edab80bd44cb.description: UK duo Overmono's 'Pure Devotion' world tour stops at Hollywood Palladium, doors 8pm with a 6:30pm Vinyl Room opener.

artist_notes.name: Massimiliano Pagliara
artist_notes.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with residencies at Berghain/Basement — Chicago house, Italo-disco and electro-disco worked through analog '70s/'80s hardware; a genuine Live at Robert Johnson / Ostgut Ton pedigree, deeply in the European lane.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

8a862e604d08.curator_note: Massimiliano Pagliara headlining Midnight Lovers is a legitimate European-club booking — Berghain-lineage electro-disco with Masha Mar and James Axon rounding it out with LA's own deep-house/dublab crowd. This is the kind of night the fabric-London comparison is actually built for.
8a862e604d08.description: Midnight Lovers presents Berlin's Massimiliano Pagliara at The Bridge, DTLA, with Masha Mar and James Axon, 9pm.

artist_notes.name: DRAMA
artist_notes.note: Chicago R&B/dance duo — producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — genre-blurring pop/dance/jazz songwriting; played Coachella alongside Frank Ocean and Gorillaz.

48e360ba751a.curator_note: Sofi Tukker at the Greek is a Spotify-core-rotation lock, not a discovery pick — a fun big-room night if you're already a fan, and DRAMA's a genuinely tasteful opener rather than filler.
48e360ba751a.description: Sofi Tukker headlines the Greek Theatre with support from DRAMA, 7:30pm.

artist_notes.name: DJ Susan
artist_notes.note: Alias of Steven Glathe (Hood Politics Records, San Diego) — bass/tech-house built for big builds and gritty drops, several Beatport #1s. More festival-EDM energy than a groove selector.

f78e396da172.curator_note: Labor Day rooftop pool party checks the setting boxes (near home, Saturday, open-air), but DJ Susan is a build-and-drop bass-house guy, not a digger — go for the pool and the day-drinking, not a deep set.
f78e396da172.description: Labor Day Saturday daytime pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8's rooftop deck headlined by bass/tech-house DJ Susan.

d8703a4e567c.curator_note: No lineup posted yet for this one — it's the same Paradisco disco-house residency at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang that brings Scotty Boy back two weeks later, so probably the house DJs, but worth a lineup check before committing a Saturday night to it.
d8703a4e567c.description: Late-night (10pm) disco/house party in the Paradisco series at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang, Koreatown — lineup TBA.

artist_notes.name: Bayymack
artist_notes.note: LA-based artist blending hip-hop, pop and rock (alt-hip-hop/'scene' crossover — collabs with 6arelyhuman, Lil Raven) — not a DJ/producer in the house-techno sense.

3311cff0ac9d.curator_note: This reads as a Y2K/'scene'-revival night built around Bayymack's hip-hop-pop, not a house or techno booking — fun if you're into that throwback-emo-rap aesthetic, but it's not really your lane despite the late-night 1720 slot.
3311cff0ac9d.description: Late-night (10pm) Y2K-themed 'scene' party at 1720 in the Arts District with alt-hip-hop artist Bayymack.

artist_notes.name: Apache
artist_notes.note: Miami-based, French-born DJ/producer on Abracadabra Records (Miami house/techno label) and founder of the Soundtuary party series — warm, groove-driven house suited to a rooftop-pool crowd.

e46641e7b265.curator_note: A genuine rooftop-pool day party — Apache isn't a name you'll recognize, but Abracadabra's house lane is legit groove, not brostep-adjacent EDM, and the setting alone (2-8pm, DTLA rooftop) is the Sunset-Sessions kind of afternoon you like.
e46641e7b265.description: Daytime rooftop pool party (2-8pm) at Level 8 DTLA headlined by Miami house DJ Apache.

artist_notes.name: Rich Medina
artist_notes.note: Philly institution, 25+ years in — founder of Jump n Funk (North America's original Afrobeat party) and one of the great genre-agnostic all-night selectors, moving through house, soul, afrobeat, funk, breaks and rare groove.

2c126d230d6c.curator_note: An open-to-close Rich Medina set billed explicitly as house/rare-groove/garage is exactly the deep-crate education worth clearing a whole Saturday night for at a tiki bar like High Tide.
2c126d230d6c.description: All-night open-to-close set (10pm) from Philly selector Rich Medina — house, rare groove and garage classics — at High Tide's Little Tokyo/Arts District bar.

artist_notes.name: Dublon
artist_notes.note: Oslo producer/DJ who went viral on TikTok with jazz-inflected house ('Summer in Marseile,' 'belle') — his 'Nectar' EP features jazz saxophonist Nathan Haines; real touring history across European clubs (London's Jazz Café) despite the social-media breakout.

bf5bb21c979b.curator_note: TikTok-viral is a red flag on paper, but the jazz-house sound is legit and a 5pm rooftop slot at Harbor House is the right room for it — closer to a sunset groove set than a hype booking.
bf5bb21c979b.description: 5pm sunset rooftop party at Harbor House DTLA headlined by Oslo jazz-house producer Dublon.

artist_notes.name: Gabriella Rose
artist_notes.note: Coeur d'Alene singer-songwriter blending vintage country, indie folk and pop — broke through as the featured vocalist on Zach Bryan's 'Madeline.' Opening this leg of Kacey's tour.

6d1613301e21.curator_note: Not remotely the club lane, but Kacey's a real Spotify staple for you and this is the 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour hitting DTLA — go for the songs, not the scene.
6d1613301e21.description: Kacey Musgraves' 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour at Crypto.com Arena, with singer-songwriter Gabriella Rose opening.

artist_notes.name: Estevie
artist_notes.note: LA-based mainstream-pop artist — catchy, hooky songwriting, not a name outside pop-radio circles. Opening this second DTLA date on Kacey's tour.

c5a4ec16269a.curator_note: Same arena run as the night before, just a different opener (LA pop act Estevie instead of Gabriella Rose) — pick whichever date works, the calculus doesn't change.
c5a4ec16269a.description: Kacey Musgraves' 'Middle of Nowhere' arena tour, second Crypto.com Arena date, with pop artist Estevie opening.

artist_notes.name: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong
artist_notes.note: Baltimore funk/jam band — extended improvisational jams over a funk-rock base, built around a dedicated touring jam-scene fanbase rather than club culture.

999952fc903e.curator_note: This is a proper jam band, not remotely house or techno, but Teragram is one of the better small rooms in the city for a live set and a funk-forward jam show there on a Friday is a fine change of pace if you're not chasing a DJ that night.
999952fc903e.description: Baltimore funk/jam band Pigeons Playing Ping Pong's Fall Tour stop at Teragram Ballroom.

artist_notes.name: Loco Dice
artist_notes.note: Tunisian-German DJ (Yassine Ben Achour), Düsseldorf — Desolat founder, Space/Hi Ibiza resident; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythms into house and tech house.

artist_notes.name: Archie Hamilton
artist_notes.note: London DJ/producer/label owner — an early architect of a rugged, atmospheric minimal-house-and-techno sound; MicroHertz label boss and a Paradise Ibiza regular.

a8308138ea4b.curator_note: A genuine international techno name doing a full daytime set in the park instead of a token festival slot — Loco Dice's hip-hop-inflected tech house plus Archie Hamilton's rugged European minimal is close to the platonic ideal of this lane.

artist_notes.note: Tokyo DJ/producer Momoko 'Moko' Goto — eclectic, colorful disco/house/pop selector known for a widely-circulated Boiler Room Tokyo set.

artist_notes.note: NY-via-Tokyo selector, founder of the PACIFIC MODE party series — tripped-out house and tech.

artist_notes.name: Axel Boman
artist_notes.note: Swedish producer and Studio Barnhus co-founder — playful, eclectic deep house with a loose, jammy feel (his 'Purple Drank' and marathon festival sets are genre-defining); this is basically his label's home-turf party.

artist_notes.name: Kornél Kovács
artist_notes.note: Studio Barnhus co-founder alongside Axel Boman — bright, melodic, disco-tinged house; one of the most purely fun-first DJs in the European house scene.

artist_notes.name: Nikki Nair
artist_notes.note: Atlanta producer/DJ blending techno, electro, breaks and UK bass into something genre-agnostic and physical — releases on Dirtybird and Lobster Theremin, mentored early by Underground Resistance's Mike Banks.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based selector who co-founded Dig Deeper LA and co-runs Take It Outside — cosmic disco, deep house and left-field selections.

artist_notes.name: Tottie
artist_notes.note: Dublab-affiliated LA radio host and co-founder of SOS Music, a !K7-backed label/platform spotlighting women and non-binary electronic artists.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control, Machine Club lineage) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

f32e99937543.curator_note: Both Studio Barnhus co-founders in one room for an outdoor day party is the label doing exactly what it does best — warm, playful house that doesn't take itself too seriously. Nikki Nair going way outside that lane only makes the bill more interesting.
f32e99937543.description: Studio Barnhus label showcase at The Bridge, DTLA, with co-founders Axel Boman and Kornél Kovács plus Nikki Nair, Masha Mar, Tottie and Stacy Christine (Sat 9/5, 5pm).

artist_notes.name: DJ Sneak
artist_notes.note: Chicago house OG ('the Turntable Terrorist') — jacking, sample-heavy garage-house going back to the early-'90s Cajmere/Relief era, still DJing at that level today.

956e5fc378e0.curator_note: DJ Sneak going all night on vinyl only is the kind of booking that makes a TBA text worth waiting for — Chicago jacking house from one of its actual architects, not a nostalgia lap.
956e5fc378e0.description: DJ Sneak plays an all-night, vinyl-only set at a TBA Downtown LA location (Sat 9/5, 10pm).

5997a24526ee.description: Wavves headline an all-ages day bill at The Belasco with Modern Color, Waax, Beach Bums, The Paranoyds and Sludge Mother.
5997a24526ee.curator_note: Reads more like a surf-punk/garage day festival than a straight headline show — Wavves still has the songs, but Waax and The Paranoyds are strong enough on their own that it's worth showing up early instead of just catching the top of the bill.

artist_notes.name: Wavves
artist_notes.note: Nathan Williams' surf-punk/lo-fi indie project out of San Diego — bratty, noise-caked guitar pop since 2008's 'Wavvves'; a real touring name with an actual catalog, not a local opener.

artist_notes.name: Waax
artist_notes.note: Brisbane, Australia post-punk/garage band fronted by Marie 'Maz' DeVita — raw, emotive, three albums deep (most recently 2026's 'Angel's Mess').

artist_notes.name: The Paranoyds
artist_notes.note: LA garage-rock/indie-punk four-piece out of the local DIY scene — Bratmobile-meets-Go-Go's energy, Third Man-affiliated, played Coachella and opened for Jack White.

artist_notes.name: Modern Color
artist_notes.note: Redondo Beach four-piece that started as metalcore and evolved into 'grungegaze' — alt-rock with shoegaze/hardcore edges, in the Hum/Title Fight/Deftones lineage.

f9b50c196afe.description: Scotty Boy's long-running Deep House Brunch pool party lands on Labor Day Saturday at White Rabbit Sky Lounge — the rooftop pool deck formerly known as Skybar at the Mondrian.
f9b50c196afe.curator_note: Scotty Boy plays it crowd-pleasing and polished rather than deep-digger, but that iconic Skybar pool deck at golden hour is doing most of the work here anyway.

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Vegas-based house veteran (25+ years, three Billboard Dance #1s) and founder of DTLA's long-running 'Deep House Brunch' — plays crowd-friendly deep/jackin' house and nu-disco edits, more festival-polish than underground digger.

cee1a18ba438.description: Indie vintage, vinyl, and handmade market; free entry and parking (Fri 10am–3:30pm, Sat 8:30am–3:30pm, Sun 9:30am–3:30pm).

43b0fbb29a65.description: TUNNEL afterhours with DJ Gigola, Annie Lew, Etari, and OZA at a TBA downtown location (11pm).

6b877afff2ca.description: Ukrainian melodic-techno/progressive-house DJ Korolova headlines a late-night set at Avalon Hollywood.
6b877afff2ca.curator_note: She's a legit DJ Mag top-60 name working the Anjunabeats/Tomorrowland melodic-techno lane — not underground-digger territory, but a genuinely festival-caliber headliner landing in a club-sized room for once.

artist_notes.name: Korolova
artist_notes.note: Olga Korolova — Ukrainian melodic-techno/progressive-house producer, ex-ballet dancer turned DJ; runs the Captive Soul label/radio show, plays Tomorrowland mainstage and EDC, DJ Mag top-60 (2024).

artist_notes.note: Melbourne producer (Fintan Bradley) running his own Mutual Pleasure label — ghetto house, Miami bass, Detroit techno and ghettotech smashed together into loud, wild, high-energy sets; a real touring draw, not a support-slot name.

artist_notes.note: Indian-Dutch, London-based — Rinse FM resident and Boiler Room regular known for blending baile funk, amapiano, dancehall, jungle and UK garage into one set. Not house/techno, but a legitimately international name for a warehouse booking.

artist_notes.name: Cquestt
artist_notes.note: Courtney Hollinquest — LA native, ex-touring backup dancer turned DJ who founded Baile World in 2020 as an Afro-Latina-led party fusing baile funk, reggaeton, dancehall and Black club music.

artist_notes.name: Mango & Ginger
artist_notes.note: Brazil-by-way-of-LA DJ duo built around baile funk and Afro-diasporic rhythms; best known for NYC's 'Favela Fridays' at SOB's, also play regularly on the LA/Baile World circuit.

01a459c44368.curator_note: This is warehouse energy but not really the house/techno lane — it's baile funk, dancehall, and global-club selecting. Jyoty's the real draw here (Rinse FM resident, plays the rooms that matter), and Cquestt built Baile World from nothing into a real thing, so the selection will be sharp even off-lane.

sounds_like: Roni Size & Reprazent's 'New Forms' era jungle

artist_notes.name: Roni Size
artist_notes.note: British jungle/drum-and-bass pioneer — Reprazent's Mercury Prize-winning 'New Forms' (1997) is a genre landmark; a genuine dnb legend outside the usual festival circuit.

artist_notes.name: Dieselboy
artist_notes.note: US drum-and-bass mainstay since the '90s, key to breaking the sound stateside (Human Imprint) — breakbeat-heavy, high-energy sets.

artist_notes.name: BAUGRUPPE90
artist_notes.note: German techno duo (Louis Köhler & Paul Vogler) fusing 90s dnb/house/early-2000s-techno textures into a driving, industrial-leaning sound — releases on Sous Music, Steel City Dance Discs, and their own MONTAGE imprint.

artist_notes.name: Coffintexts
artist_notes.note: Miami producer (Alexandra Muggli, Peruvian heritage) blending UK-style techno with bass-heavy, tempo-shifting global rhythms — hardgroove and tribal-house leaning, a rising RA-radar name.

artist_notes.name: Trax Unit
artist_notes.note: LA underground techno duo (Kyle Galindo & Kian Mahroo), Dublab residents who run the local Gyration Station label — stripped-down, analog-grit techno, an actual local scene name rather than a touring import.

bba298f54256.curator_note: This isn't the vinyl-and-rooftop lane — it's INCOGNITO's 20th-anniversary warehouse weekend, hardgroove techno sliding into full-tilt drum & bass, with actual scene royalty (Roni Size, Dieselboy) instead of the usual local bill. Worth it if you want proof LA's underground rave scene still has teeth.
bba298f54256.description: INCOGNITO's 20th-anniversary warehouse weekend (TBA location, Sep 4-5) spans hardgroove techno and drum & bass, headlined by dnb legends Roni Size and Dieselboy, with BAUGRUPPE90, Coffintexts, Trax Unit, and residents Newty and WHYS.

sounds_like: CloZee/Govinda-style glitch-hop-meets-world-bass, with live violin and didgeridoo over DJ sets

artist_notes.name: Josh Teed
artist_notes.note: Classically-trained violinist turned bass-music producer — live sets layer violin, didgeridoo and analog synth over DJ sets, in the Charlesthefirst/CloZee/Govinda festival-bass lineage.

4cb3f7503914.curator_note: Off the house/techno spine entirely — Josh Teed's a bass-music/festival-circuit name, not a club-groove one, so it's a different crowd than the usual pick here. Baby Kush and Dvnk didn't turn up enough to say anything real about.
4cb3f7503914.description: B-Side LA books bass-music producer Josh Teed (violin/didgeridoo hybrid live sets) with Baby Kush and Dvnk at The Melrose House.

artist_notes.name: DJ Masda
artist_notes.note: Japan-born, Berlin-based co-founder of CABARET Recordings — vinyl digger since the '90s pulling from early techno, futurist electro and playful house; RA Podcast/Dimensions pedigree, has played LA's Pattern Bar before.

artist_notes.name: Mesmé
artist_notes.note: LA DJ/producer (debut EP on Mall Grab's Steel City Dance Discs) — vinyl-heavy blends of moody acid, electro, house and trip-hop; Into the Woods and Dublab resident, Boiler Room 2021.

artist_notes.name: Etari
artist_notes.note: LA producer (Alixandria Andre) — hypnotic house and broken-beat selector who's played Lights Down Low and Incognito and a HÖR Berlin set; Yellow Island Records.

artist_notes.name: Connor Mikami
artist_notes.note: Founder of If You Know You Know, the LA party/label series this event IS — longtime local selector working vintage breaks, electro and club records.

artist_notes.name: Chemtrail Johnny
artist_notes.note: SoCal DJ/producer working in minimal, laid-back house and techno grooves — low profile but a real local scene name.

46262ef3c094.curator_note: Connor Mikami's own IYKYK series flying in DJ Masda's Tokyo-to-Berlin house/techno digging, but the real story is the bench underneath him — Mesmé and Etari are both legit names on their own nights. TBA spot means expect a real underground room, not a listed venue.
46262ef3c094.description: TBA-location LA night from Connor Mikami's IYKYK series, headlined by Berlin-based DJ Masda (CABARET Recordings) with Mesmé, Etari and Chemtrail Johnny in support.

sounds_like: hypnotic, dense techno in the Inner Tension/SXTCY mold

artist_notes.name: Anastasia Giovani
artist_notes.note: LA underground techno regular — SXTCY resident known for dark, raw, propulsive sets; also runs VSCRL, a modular/vinyl/noise-leaning event series.

artist_notes.name: Blazej Malinowski
artist_notes.note: Polish, Berlin-based techno producer — founder of the Inner Tension label, deep and hypnotic productions on Semantica and Silent Season.

artist_notes.name: Kameliia
artist_notes.note: Oslo-based techno DJ (Bulgarian-born) — self-described 'mental techno,' driving and atmospheric, releases on Token and SK_eleven; has played Berghain, Fold and Berlin Atonal.

artist_notes.name: Secus
artist_notes.note: LA techno producer (Matt Salamone) — half of Motionen, co-founder of label Ascetic Limited; jazz/metal-informed, hard and agitated techno.

5d50585cdb35.curator_note: A legit deep-techno afterhours booking — Berlin's Blazej Malinowski and Oslo's Kameliia flying in alongside LA's own Anastasia Giovani and Secus for a 5am TBA start. Hypnotic, dense end of the spectrum, not big-room — worth it only if you're actually built for a real after-hours.
5d50585cdb35.description: TBA-location LA techno afterhours (5am start) — SYNTHESIS's second edition pairs Berlin's Blazej Malinowski and Oslo's Kameliia with LA regulars Anastasia Giovani and Secus.

95baa547ce43.curator_note: EMX's long-running Friday-night residency at Los Globos, branded 'Tech House Takeover' — two rooms, no billed lineup, and it runs on a near-weekly basis. A generic local club night, not one to prioritize.

artist_notes.name: Konduku
artist_notes.note: Ruben Üvez — Dutch producer based in Berlin, releases on Nous'klaer Audio and Delsin — hypnotic, detail-heavy techno with a UK bass-culture streak; a selector's selector, not a big-room name.

artist_notes.note: Pavel Milyakov — Moscow underground fixture (John's Kingdom collective, tight with Gost Zvuk and Klasse Wrecks) making spacious, dystopian techno; this is a live set, not a DJ set.

dadf61c46a60.curator_note: This is the real deal — Jen Cardini's Correspondant/Rex Club pedigree, Buttechno bringing his raw Moscow techno live, and Konduku's hypnotic, UK-bass-inflected style, all in a TBA DTLA warehouse running to 5am. About as close to a proper European club night as LA gets.

artist_notes.note: Bassist/singer of SF post-punk trio Grass Widow and darkwave project Cold Beat, now a few years into a self-titled solo run that critics compare to early New Order and Fad Gadget — underground pedigree, not a casual pop booking.

artist_notes.note: LA experimental guitarist, co-founder of cult NYC noise-pop duo Talk Normal and current touring guitarist for Kim Gordon — heavier underground cred than the bill's pop framing suggests.

9f0f8bea7e78.curator_note: Not the house/vinyl lane, but a genuinely credible underground-indie bill — Grass Widow and Talk Normal pedigree dressed up as a KCRW pop night. Worth it if the post-punk/dream-pop side of the taste is in the mood.

c2beb10930d8.curator_note: ANOTR is a legit big-room tech-house draw right now, and Factory 93 putting it under the 6th Street Bridge is a real venue flex — this is the mainstream-headliner-that-still-counts lane, not filler.

artist_notes.name: Akumen
artist_notes.note: Chinatown-based LA house/techno/disco DJ-producer and Made to Move co-founder — releases on Fortune Signal and Juke Bounce Werk, played BBC Radio 1, Rinse FM, and NTS.

artist_notes.name: agraybé
artist_notes.note: LA/Minnesota DJ (Ariana Gray Bé), part of the Made to Move orbit — psychedelic, groove-forward house selections; releases via Kajunga.

artist_notes.name: Andy Oro
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, host of the Oro Hour on VPN Radio and a Made to Move resident — eclectic underground/house sets pulling from DIY dance music, hip-hop and bloghouse.

artist_notes.name: Dj Kerry
artist_notes.note: LA DJ since 2005, longtime Dublab radio host and founder of The Basement, a membership-based party rooted in Paradise Garage/West Coast warehouse tradition.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

artist_notes.name: Xica Soul
artist_notes.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

artist_notes.name: Rivussy
artist_notes.note: River Collins — non-binary Afro-Caribbean DJ out of LA/North Long Beach blending techno, ghetto house, vogue and club music.

7c43ef473db9.curator_note: Nine deep on the bill and the anchor names are genuinely real — Akumen's the co-founder, and Kerry, Stacy Christine, Xica Soul and agraybé are all legit LA underground-house selectors, not padding for a free anniversary flyer.
7c43ef473db9.description: Free 8-year-anniversary party for Made to Move, the LA house night, with a stacked local lineup including Akumen, agraybé, Andy Oro and DJ Kerry at General Lee's Cocktail House.

8a7d37b91c68.description: Eventbrite-listed house night at The Virgil billed as 'Felix & Friends,' 21+, no lineup beyond Felix.

artist_notes.name: SG Lewis
artist_notes.note: British DJ/producer/songwriter — warm, disco-etched dance-pop (albums 'times', 'AudioLust & HigherLove'); has written and produced with Dua Lipa, Robyn and Nile Rodgers.

artist_notes.name: Hot Chip
artist_notes.note: Long-running London electronic band (since 2000, early DFA ties) — dance-rock/electropop ('Over and Over,' 'Ready For The Floor') with a big, festival-tested live show.

artist_notes.name: Austin Millz
artist_notes.note: Harlem-raised, NYC-based DJ/producer blending hip-hop with dance/house — DJ'd Beyoncé's 'Homecoming' Coachella sets and played Boiler Room NYC.

artist_notes.name: Nala
artist_notes.note: LA-via-Miami producer/DJ (Stefania Aronin) — acid house and indie-dance with a punky, off-kilter edge; Dirtybird signee and Lights Down Low resident who runs the label Mi Domina.

artist_notes.name: Blond:ish
artist_notes.note: Canadian-Swiss duo (Anstascia, Vivie-Ann) — melodic/organic house with an eco-conscious rave ethos; co-founded the No.19 Music label.

artist_notes.name: Poolside
artist_notes.note: LA duo (Filip Nikolic, Jeffrey Paradise) who more or less invented 'daytime disco' — slow-motion, sun-baked grooves ('Harvest Moon,' 'Do You Believe'). About as squarely built for a beach day as it gets.

artist_notes.name: Vandelux
artist_notes.note: Vancouver-born, SF-based producer/vocalist (Evan White) — groove-driven electronic/soul/indie; 'Matter of Time' charted on Billboard Dance.

artist_notes.name: Good Neighbours
artist_notes.note: UK indie-pop duo (Oli Fox, Scott Verrill) behind 2024's viral hit 'Home' — tropical-leaning, early-2000s-indie-indebted pop, more festival crossover than club.

1d2529b6944a.curator_note: DJ Harvey, Poolside and Blond:ish give this real disco/house teeth, but Hot Chip, SG Lewis and Good Neighbours pull it toward general-festival territory rather than a pure dance lineup — go for the beach-day format and the top of the bill, not expecting a club night.
1d2529b6944a.description: Two-day beach festival at Santa Monica Beach (Sat noon–Sun 10pm) mixing disco/house (DJ Harvey, Poolside, Blond:ish, Carlita) with dance-pop and indie names (Hot Chip, SG Lewis, Good Neighbours).

artist_notes.name: Momo Trosman
artist_notes.note: Buenos Aires-born DJ/producer, DJing professionally since 2011 with European tours behind him — dub- and jazz-informed digging across UK/US house, electro and techno; co-runs the Cure Music label.

artist_notes.name: Cromie
artist_notes.note: Zagreb-born, LA-based producer — Balearic-fringe house: crisp grooves, warm melodies and hazy breaks, released via Amadeus Records and Duality Trax.

e0bf9830cfa7.curator_note: This is the TBA-warehouse afterhours format Ari already likes, and the lineup is a notch deeper than most of them — Momo Trosman and Cromie are legit diggers, not just names filling a flyer.
e0bf9830cfa7.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (10pm-8am) with tech-house/breaks selectors Gene On Earth, Momo Trosman, Cromie, Chemtrail Johnny, Hazy, Ian Llorens and Gilbert0.

artist_notes.name: Mario Liberti
artist_notes.note: Peru-born DJ who cut his teeth in Miami (Techno Loft, Club Space, Un_Mute) and is now based between Lima, Miami and Paris — founder of Deep In Dis, the label/party this showcase is named for; deep, hypnotic techno and house.

ed1c84324757.curator_note: A cheap, late TBA showcase built around Deep In Dis's own founder — solid if you're already out in DTLA that night, but two of the five names (CHOÍCE, Mikeb) I couldn't verify, so treat this as a minor pick rather than a must.
ed1c84324757.description: TBA-location DTLA afterhours (11pm-6am) showcasing Mario Liberti's Deep In Dis label/party with CHOÍCE, Chemtrail Johnny, Hazy and Mikeb.

artist_notes.name: DJ Tennis
artist_notes.note: Manfredi Romano — Italian scene godfather who founded Life and Death in 2010 (Tale Of Us, Mind Against and Carlita all came up through the label); globally touring, melodic house/techno selector with real Innervisions-adjacent ties via the Rakastella festival.

artist_notes.name: Kaz James
artist_notes.note: Australian DJ/producer with old-school pedigree — a decade-long Pacha Ibiza residency ('We Are The Night') behind him, now making straight-up house that's charted with tracks like 'Not in Love' and 'Footprints.'

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (Dig Deeper LA, Take It Outside, the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — cosmic disco, deep house and left-field edits.

09590633eec8.curator_note: Âme headlining an outdoor Chinatown block party is close to the fabric-London energy Ari's after — DJ Tennis and Kaz James make this a genuinely stacked bill, not just a headliner carrying two openers.
09590633eec8.description: Melodic house/techno duo Âme (Innervisions co-founders) headlines an outdoor Chinatown block party on Gin Ling Way (6pm-12am) with Life and Death's DJ Tennis, Kaz James and Masha Mar.

artist_notes.name: Mark Farina
artist_notes.note: Chicago-born, SF-based house legend behind the long-running 'Mushroom Jazz' series — a jazzy, downtempo-inflected strain of house he's been refining since the mid-90s.

artist_notes.name: Josh Wink
artist_notes.note: Philadelphia techno/house legend ('Higher State of Consciousness') and Ovum Recordings co-founder since 1994 — still a headline-level booking three decades in.

artist_notes.name: DJ Dazy
artist_notes.note: LA house DJ since 1992 — founded the all-female Sister DJs collective, deep and soulful vinyl-rooted sets, part of the West Coast house lineage this bill leans on.

artist_notes.name: Your Unkle Magik
artist_notes.note: Vinyl-only house selector, a regular on the Certified Groovers/DTLA open-air circuit.

artist_notes.name: Tom Carle
artist_notes.note: LA underground DJ working deep/minimal tech-house and techno — longtime host of a DJ podcast since 2018, regular alongside DJ Sneak and J-Dub on the CHI♡LA circuit.

4ecd0fcd718a.curator_note: A three-day house marathon built around DJ Sneak's birthday with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina and Josh Wink on the bill — this is Chicago-house royalty depth you don't see stacked this thick very often, TBA location aside.
4ecd0fcd718a.description: Multi-day (Sat 4pm–Mon 2am) house celebration for DJ Sneak's birthday, TBA location, with Derrick Carter, Mark Farina, Josh Wink, DJ Heather, John Tejada and a deep bench of Chicago-rooted house DJs.

57301c93001a.curator_note: No DJs listed yet for this one — read it as El Cid doing its reliable feel-good house/disco thing rather than a can't-miss night.
57301c93001a.description: House and disco party at El Cid in Silver Lake (9:30pm-2am), free with RSVP before 10pm.

artist_notes.name: Marques Wyatt
artist_notes.note: West Coast deep-house legend — ran LA's long-running Deep party/residency from the late '90s into the 2010s, credited with helping put LA's dance scene on the map alongside NYC and Miami.

artist_notes.name: Doc Martin
artist_notes.note: West Coast house pioneer, moved SF to LA in the early '90s and founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026) — deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

artist_notes.name: David Harness
artist_notes.note: Bay Area deep-house DJ/producer/remixer (credits with Mary J. Blige, Alicia Keys) — soulful, classic house across Coachella, Glastonbury and beyond.

artist_notes.name: Big Cee
artist_notes.note: Chris Legaspi — the longtime resident opening DJ at Marques Wyatt's DEEP, a foundational figure in LA's house community who's shared decks with Frankie Knuckles and Louie Vega.

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: Bronx-born, LA-based DJ steeped in NYC's '90s golden-era house and disco/boogie — has drawn attention from Louie Vega and DJ Sneak.

6d1f5bc4515a.curator_note: Two genuine West Coast deep-house elders trading b2b at an outdoor DTLA plaza is a real occasion, not a routine club booking — and David Harness plus Big Cee and SEEPS underneath means the whole afternoon is deep-house pedigree, not just the top line.
6d1f5bc4515a.description: Marques Wyatt and Doc Martin b2b at California Plaza (1pm-9pm), with David Harness, Big Cee and SEEPS — an outdoor deep-house celebration from LA scene veterans.

75336cad1aec.curator_note: Same El Cid disco-night format as Dopamine, no lineup announced — a fine cheap Saturday if you're already in Silver Lake, not a destination booking.
75336cad1aec.description: Disco party at El Cid in Silver Lake (9:30pm-2am).

artist_notes.name: Lovefingers
artist_notes.note: Andrew Hogge — LA Balearic/disco digger and shaman of ESP Institute, the label/party he's run for two decades; longtime DJ Harvey collaborator in the same cosmic-disco lineage.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector out of the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse.

artist_notes.name: Bears In Space
artist_notes.note: The LA collective throwing this one — Chris Bowen and Victor Rodriguez have run it since 2009, one of the city's longest-standing queer disco/house day parties, historically pulling guests like DJ Harvey and Horse Meat Disco.

artist_notes.name: Stacy Christine
artist_notes.note: LA warehouse-scene DJ since 2012 (Music For Dancers, Critter Control) — joyful house into kinetic techno; has opened for DJ Harvey, Moodymann, and Honey Dijon.

artist_notes.name: Cocteautwinks
artist_notes.note: LA all-vinyl DJ (Mino Sanchez) — a local cult favorite mixing '90s nostalgia with queer/alternative sensibility; visual artist as much as selector.

b92eae62d6ed.curator_note: The lineup is legit — Lovefingers and Heidi Lawden are both real DJ Harvey-orbit diggers, not filler — but this is a queer disco day party down to its bones, not a rooftop-groove afternoon that happens to skew that way.
b92eae62d6ed.description: Outdoor season-closer lot party for Bears in Space, the long-running queer disco day party at Akbar, with ESP Institute's Lovefingers and Balearic/house selector Heidi Lawden.

0892ad31c23d.curator_note: Generic promoter warehouse night — DJ D.KODA, KittenParty and MOOv don't turn up anywhere with a real touring or scene footprint, so this reads as a local afterhours booking rather than a lineup worth planning around.
0892ad31c23d.description: Late-night tech-house and hip-hop warehouse party in the Arts District from promoter Bigexpression, running 9pm-2am.

2ea674a1cd69.curator_note: A recurring first-and-third-Saturday disco night at Gold Diggers with no billed lineup yet — could be a solid neighborhood groove night, but there's nothing here yet to distinguish it from any other night of the residency.
2ea674a1cd69.description: First-and-third-Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood.

artist_notes.name: Oppidan
artist_notes.note: UK garage producer, one of the faster-rising names in the current UKG wave — blends 2-step with 4x4 NUKG and bass; a genre pick rather than a straight house/techno booking.

5360e31e4b2e.curator_note: A solo headline set from a rising UK garage name — good if you want UKG specifically, but it's a headliner-only booking at Academy with no support billed yet.
5360e31e4b2e.description: Solo headline set from UK garage producer Oppidan at Academy LA.

8e7813093f04.curator_note: Scotty Boy is more festival-polish than underground digger — crowd-friendly deep and jackin' house, not a deep-crate session — but free at Kiss Kiss Bang Bang on a Saturday is an easy yes regardless.

artist_notes.name: Richie Hawtin
artist_notes.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers.

artist_notes.name: DJ Tennis
artist_notes.note: Manfredi Romano — Italian scene godfather who founded Life and Death in 2010 (Tale Of Us, Mind Against and Carlita all came up through the label); a globally touring, melodic house/techno selector.

fc02f613287a.curator_note: Insomniac's Halloween mega-fest buries real house/techno headliners — Hawtin, Kraviz, Capriati, DJ Tennis, Jamie Jones — under a dozen stages of hardstyle, dubstep, and bass. Worth it for a specific set, not for the vibe of the thing as a whole.
fc02f613287a.description: Insomniac's Halloween festival at NOS Events Center in San Bernardino, spanning house/techno headliners (Richie Hawtin, Nina Kraviz, Joseph Capriati) alongside trance, dubstep, and hardstyle stages.

artist_notes.name: Ferry Corsten
artist_notes.note: Dutch trance OG since the late-90s boom (System F, Gouryella with a young Tiësto) who now runs his own Flashover label and plays a broader, more contemporary progressive-leaning set.

artist_notes.name: Artbat
artist_notes.note: Ukrainian duo (Artur Kryvenko & Vitalii Limarenko) — melodic techno breakout via Solomun's Diynamic label ('Upperground', 'Atlas'); one of the names most responsible for melodic techno's mainstream crossover.

artist_notes.name: Enrico Sangiuliano
artist_notes.note: Italian techno producer, one of Drumcode's biggest-selling artists for a stretch (Adam Beyer's label) — hypnotic, sci-fi-tinged peak-time techno built for big rooms.

artist_notes.name: BT
artist_notes.note: Brian Transeau — one of American trance's founding names since the late-90s, still touring a big, cinematic, melody-forward sound.

0805854dd8f8.curator_note: Trance is mostly outside the lane, but this is the genre's biggest annual SoCal gathering, and Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano's melodic-techno sets are a real reason to go beyond nostalgia for Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten.
0805854dd8f8.description: Insomniac's SoCal trance festival, headlined by Above & Beyond and Ferry Corsten with melodic-techno crossover sets from Artbat and Enrico Sangiuliano.

bcbe10ce2a88.curator_note: No lineup posted yet for this Halloween-week booking — 1720 is a dependable warehouse-techno room, but hard to rate blind at $46.
bcbe10ce2a88.description: Halloween-week party at 1720 in the Arts District; lineup not yet announced.

artist_notes.name: yaego
artist_notes.note: PG County, Maryland-raised producer blending dark, melodic house with cinematic build — a fast-rising TikTok/SoundCloud name ('Fe en Rebelion,' 'HARDX') more than an established club headliner yet.

02d774d6c10a.curator_note: Lights Down Low is one of LA's most dependable underground house/techno series — worth going for the room and crowd even though yaego is more a rising internet-native name than a proven headliner.

artist_notes.name: Dave Aju
artist_notes.note: SF producer (Marc Barrite) and longtime Circus Company artist — soulful, left-field minimal house built from his own vocals and samples; played Fabric, Panorama Bar and Rex Club. A genuinely deep booking for a Halloween party.

artist_notes.name: Heidi Lawden
artist_notes.note: LA-via-London selector out of the '90s UK queer rave scene — house/techno/disco marathon sets and a longtime DJ Harvey tour collaborator/muse.

artist_notes.name: Masha Mar
artist_notes.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

artist_notes.name: Tavish
artist_notes.note: Venice-native LA warehouse-scene DJ (also a Grammy-winning producer as half of Sid Roams) — industrial disco and acid house; a fixture across the city's underground circuit alongside names like Psychemagik and DJ Garth.

artist_notes.name: Things You Say
artist_notes.note: LA club-scene DJ project posting house mixes and playing local nights — low profile, nothing more substantial to verify beyond that.

fb61cd32ee4f.curator_note: Yamashiro's hillside gardens plus a genuinely deep bill — Dave Aju's Circus Company pedigree next to Heidi Lawden and Masha Mar's disco digging — makes this a rare Halloween party actually worth dressing up for.
fb61cd32ee4f.description: Halloween costume party in Yamashiro's hillside gardens with house/disco DJs Dave Aju, Heidi Lawden, Masha Mar, Tavish and Things You Say.

02f1f6e2ff68.curator_note: Three unknown local names on the Roadhouse's Cypress Park stage — no dependable info on Cruise Control, Candle or The Century, so this reads as a wildcard $10 bar show rather than a pick.
02f1f6e2ff68.description: $10 all-ages bar show at Permanent Records Roadhouse with Cruise Control, Candle and The Century.

artist_notes.name: Anfisa Letyago
artist_notes.note: Naples-scene-turned-global techno DJ/producer (Russian-born, Italy-based) — hypnotic, groove-driven techno/house; Moby tapped her for a 2022 'Go' remix, and she runs her own label N:S:DA.

04471a755954.curator_note: A real international techno headliner landing in a proper DTLA room on her own night, not sharing a festival stage — worth the Saturday if you're in a techno mood.
04471a755954.description: Solo headline techno set from Italy-based DJ/producer Anfisa Letyago at Exchange LA.

artist_notes.name: Luke Strand
artist_notes.note: Bay Area-raised, LA-based vocalist/multi-instrumentalist (bass, guitar, keys, trumpet) who teaches at Musicians Institute Hollywood — leads this free weekly soul/jazz/R&B hang covering decades of hits with a rotating band.

087184be27c5.curator_note: A free weekly jam-session hang, not a headline show — good for a walk-in Los Feliz night if you're already out, not for building plans around.
087184be27c5.description: No-cover weekly soul/jazz jam session at The Dresden led by vocalist-multi-instrumentalist Luke Strand, with rotating guest musicians (8:30pm).

0d0885591682.curator_note: Hard-techno/hardstyle is the one lane taste explicitly says to skip — a Samuel Moriero LA debut for that crowd, not this one.
0d0885591682.description: Hard-techno/hardstyle night at 1720 marking Samuel Moriero's LA debut (Wasted, Trinity).

artist_notes.name: Brijean
artist_notes.note: Oakland duo (Brijean Murphy & Doug Stuart) on Ghostly International — Murphy is also the touring percussionist for Poolside and Toro y Moi; their own sound is warm, congas-driven boogie/dream-pop. This is a DJ set, not the live band, so expect disco/house selections in that same breezy register.

0ec47193d563.curator_note: Brijean behind the decks rather than behind the congas is a nice change of format — her Ghostly/Poolside pedigree suggests a warm, disco-leaning selection for a Halloween night at Camille's.
0ec47193d563.description: Halloween DJ set (disco/house/pop) from Ghostly International duo Brijean at The Bellwether's Camille's night.

artist_notes.name: Giegling
artist_notes.note: The Weimar, Germany label/collective (Traumprinz aka DJ Metatron, Konstantin/Kettenkarussell, Vril, HVL and others) behind some of the most mythologized, hypnotic house and techno of the last decade — genuinely rare to see a Giegling-branded date in LA, though the listing doesn't say which member of the crew is actually playing.

0fb32652872c.curator_note: A Giegling booking in LA is unusual enough to flag even without knowing which artist from the crew is actually behind the decks — TBA location and a 6am run time both point to the real afterhours version of this, from the same Midnight Lovers crew as Masha Mar's other nights.
0fb32652872c.description: Halloween afterhours party (TBA DTLA location, 11pm-6am) presented by Midnight Lovers under the Giegling banner.

artist_notes.name: Kids in America
artist_notes.note: Touring '80s new-wave/pop tribute band (originally out of Charlotte, NC) covering hits from the decade — not an original act, so genre is pop covers rather than the venue's usual punk/rock.

10e5a0affe9c.curator_note: This is the touring '80s tribute act, not a real band — right in the cover-band/nostalgia-night bucket the taste profile skips regardless of venue.
10e5a0affe9c.description: Touring '80s new-wave/pop tribute band 'Kids in America' plays Permanent Records Roadhouse with a special-guest opener.

artist_notes.name: Sub Imperium
artist_notes.note: Producer on Occult Rhythms and Askorn Records — labels built around hard, dark, EBM-tinged techno; rougher and more industrial than the refined European techno lane.

1349d815db60.curator_note: Sub Imperium is a real name in the dark/industrial-techno underground, and the 'Final Communion' framing suggests this could be closing out the Solitary Gardens series — worth noting even though the genre (EBM/industrial) sits a notch harder than the usual pick.
1349d815db60.description: Dark techno/EBM/industrial night at 1720 headlined by Sub Imperium, part of the 'Solitary Gardens: Final Communion Rave' series, 9pm-2am.

artist_notes.name: Frank Walker

artist_notes.name: Loud Luxury
artist_notes.note: Canadian bass-house duo behind the global hit 'Body' — festival-scale, radio-friendly dance-pop.

15198557d353.curator_note: Kygo, Chainsmokers, Zedd and T-Pain is a genuinely major bill (Zedd's a tracked name), but this is a $429+ trip to Montecito for a fest that plays a lot more pop-radio than club — worth it only if the day-trip itself is the appeal, not the DJing.

16fbd16dcbe0.curator_note: Luke Strand's a legit working musician, but this is a no-cover, low-stakes jam-session night — pleasant if you're already at the Dresden, not something to route a night around.
16fbd16dcbe0.description: No-cover soulful jazz jam session led by vocalist/multi-instrumentalist Luke Strand at The Dresden.

1dad82afaaaa.curator_note: David Moscoe's a genuine fixture of the Dresden's jazz-night rotation; Matt Forbes and Jesse Goddard (the vocalists this time) don't turn up any bio beyond the listing, but the trio backing them is the real thing.
1dad82afaaaa.description: Recurring 'Swingin' Jazz Affair' crooner night at The Dresden — Matt Forbes and Jesse Goddard with the David Moscoe Trio.

dj nuts.note: Sao Paulo crate-digger revered for his Brazilian/global-beats edits (Wax Poetics 'Cultura Copia' mixtapes) — deep, eclectic, all-vinyl selector.

cut chemist.note: LA turntablist, ex-Jurassic 5 / Ozomatli — sample-collage funk and breaks; a foundational figure in the city's beats scene.

waajeed.note: Detroit producer/DJ (Bling47, Dirt Tech Reck) and Slum Village affiliate — soulful house and beats that bridge Dilla's lineage into the dancefloor.

shdw.note: Co-founder of the Mutual Rytm label and half of German duo SHDW & Obscure Shape — driving, hypnotic, melodic-leaning techno; squarely the refined European end you like.

bradley zero.note: Founder of Peckham's Rhythm Section International and the long-running NTS show — a genuine tastemaker selector spanning disco, broken beat, deep house and global grooves. One of the better daytime sets you can catch in LA this weekend.

masha mar.note: Serbian-born, LA-based DJ/curator (the Midnight Lovers crew) with NTS and Dublab residencies — Italo disco, house and dancefloor edits.

neeko.note: Resident selector for Sunday Sessions LA, the vinyl-only series at Apotheke — all-wax house and disco.

krane.note: Longtime Sunday Sessions LA resident — vinyl-only house DJ recorded across the series' open-air sets.

ayybo.note: Rising US tech-house producer, big-room festival energy — exactly the mainstream-fun end of the lane, not noise.

ragie ban.note: Brazilian house producer signed to Lake's own Black Book; their flip 'Toxic' hit Beatport #1.

dj minx.note: Detroit house matriarch, Women on Wax founder — tracked artist; deep, soulful, dancefloor-first selection.

josh caffé.note: London house vocalist/DJ and Paranoid London frontman; Black queer club energy with records on Crosstown Rebels and Classic — proper fabric-lineage stuff.

farralone.note: LA disco/house selector — couldn't verify a label home, but the billing reads classic nu-disco-into-house warmth.

trovarsi.note: LA modular/live techno artist and educator (SoCal Synth Society) — bassy, hardware-driven sets that swing from pounding to melodic.

e m bae.note: Part of the Black Techno Matters collective lineup; couldn't verify a full bio, so taking that at face value.

92jelani.note: Black Techno Matters-affiliated DJ; limited public footprint, included per the billing.

hot since 82.note: UK house heavyweight, Knee Deep In Sound boss — tracked artist; rolling, hypnotic, extended-set sensibility that elevates the whole bill.

claude vonstroke.note: Dirtybird founder (aka Barclay Crenshaw) — playful, bass-heavy West Coast house; he's billed leading the 'Team USA' set here.

ardalan.note: Tehran-born, Bay Area-raised Dirtybird mainstay — hypnotic, deep-bass house out of the Sunset Sound System lineage.

todd edwards.note: New Jersey UK-garage legend ('God of Garage') who shaped Daft Punk's sound — chopped-vocal, skippy house.

cut snake.note: Australian house duo (Sedz & Leigh Sedley) — sunny, festival-ready CRSSD-circuit house.

falcons.note: LA producer/DJ working the club-and-bass-leaning end; included per the bill.

ak chamel the giver of illness.note: Anonymous Houston duo doing desert-scorched ritual-folk and lo-fi psychedelia — masked, costumed, occult live show; fits the Zebulon experimental lane more than the dance one.

derek monypeny.note: Joshua Tree guitarist/oud + shahi baaja player (ex-Sir Richard Bishop's Freak of Araby Ensemble) — drone-to-free-jazz 'desert continuum' soundscapes.

xica soul.note: LA DJ and radio host (Artform, KQBH) — soul, funk and house, an In Sheep's Clothing-circuit selector.

cassian.note: Australian producer, Grammy-winning mixer on RÜFÜS DU SOL's 'Alive' — dark-but-dreamy melodic house; the marquee draw here.

kamino.note: London/LA/Brooklyn house & tech-house producer; broke out with 'Lower Frequency,' melody-forward but dancefloor-aimed.

eddie c.note: Canadian-in-Berlin slo-mo disco-edits heavyweight (Edward Currelly) — lush, dubby, generous grooves on Endless Flight; runs the 7 Inches of Love imprint with The Mole. A tracked name and a perfect open-to-close selector.

b wade.note: Resident behind the recurring 'Acts of Service Sounds' soulful-house night at Gold Diggers — 'sounds for the soul, all night long,' classic vocal/gospel-tinged deep house.

lydo.note: NYC-based, BASEMENT resident and X-TRA.SERVICES founder — fast, syncopated, heady techno-trance from the queer underground.

frankie teardrop.note: Montreal DJ/curator (Slut Island festival, LIP party) — high-energy queer-underground techno and rave.

tamara lanza.note: LA multi-genre DJ and Level 8 / Sunset Sessions regular — ranges disco house through deep and melodic; reliable rooftop-groove selector.

antal.note: Rush Hour co-founder, Amsterdam — one of the deepest diggers alive; obscure disco, raw house, broken beat and beyond. Flying in for this. A tracked name.

reverberation radio.note: The Allah-Las' long-running weekly podcast and DJ crew — deep-crate '60s-onward psych, surf, folk-rock, soul and global obscurities played off the records (Calico Discos label).

richie hawtin.note: Windsor/Detroit-Berlin minimal-techno icon (Plastikman, F.U.S.E.; founder of Plus 8 and M_nus) — a defining name in stripped, hypnotic techno. A tracked name; this is a free art-context set, not a club.

john gerrard.note: Irish artist behind LACMA's year-long browser-based 'SPIRITS' artwork; this solstice event is its Summer (Mediterranean) activation — gerrard appears alongside Hawtin.

dave harrington.note: Half of Darkside (with Nicolas Jaar) and a fixture of LA's improv scene — guitar/electronics-led psychedelic jams; this is his quintet.

john dwyer.note: Frontman of Oh Sees / Osees — prolific garage-psych and experimental bandleader (Castle Face Records), here in a free-improv setting.

spencer zahn.note: Composer and double-bassist working in ambient-jazz and modern-classical textures (collaborations with Dawn Richard among others).

aaron steele.note: LA/Nashville drummer-percussionist (Chrome Sparks and others) — versatile, jazz-fusion-leaning player.

tom dolas.note: Keyboardist in Oh Sees and Mr. Elevator — psych and jazz-fusion-flavored synth and keys.

yaeji.note: Brooklyn-based, Korean-American producer/DJ (Kathy Yaeji Lee) — whispered bilingual vocals over deep house and club rhythms; debut LP 'What We Drew' on XL Recordings, second album 'With A Hammer' (2023). Breakthrough Boiler Room in 2017. On a dedicated DJ-set North American summer tour 2026. Tracked name.

alima lee.note: LA-based DJ and co-founder of the Baexploitation / Hood Rave orbit — global club, footwork-adjacent and deeply communal sets.

adam beyer.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno; one of the most reliably excellent festival techno sets alive. Tracked name.

cloonee.note: Manchester-raised tech-house producer Dave Bissett (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s including 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab 'Nightmares'; one of the circuit's best crowd-movers. Tracked name.

loco dice.note: Tunisian-German DJ Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; Space/Hi Ibiza resident; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythms into house and tech house. Records on Ovum, M-nus, Cadenza, Cocoon.

hi-lo.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has released on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno bridging festival and underground.

elderbrook.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' with CamelPhat was Grammy-nominated 2018; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act, not a DJ set.

hayden james.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); worked with Gorgon City and Katy Perry; RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but slightly more radio-pop.

sidepiece.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house with Motown and '90s soul edits.

westend.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped define modern American tech house; Kick & Bass Records founder; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

josh baker.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project; also runs SYNTHO production school.

riordan.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm; also on Black Book and Catch & Release.

greg 99.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee (6.6M streams); Insomniac Records debut.

stacey pullen.note: Second-wave Detroit techno architect — studied under Derrick May, released on R&S, Transmat and Eclipse in the '90s; Blackflag Recordings founder; acclaimed DJ-Kicks (1996); also releases as Bango, Kosmik Messenger and Silent Phase. Tracked name.

bae bae.note: Kumi James — LA-born DJ/producer, sound artist, Planet Mu signee, and co-founder of Hood Rave (DTLA's queer-Black underground party). Sets weave footwork, juke, breaks and R&B through an explicitly Black-diasporic and femme lens; NTS and Dublab radio host.

nish.note: LA/Boracay-raised DJ — groove-forward soulful house and global rhythms with an intention-first approach; active in the Westside Bounce and LA underground circuits.

dj toka.note: Resident at Sudamericana, LA's long-running Latin dance party (founded 2012) — plays between classic South American rhythms, house and disco edits in an unpretentious, inclusive room.

robert hood.note: Detroit minimal-techno originator and M-Plant founder — co-founded Underground Resistance with Jeff Mills and Mad Mike Banks; stripped techno to bare drum/bassline essentials on 'Internal Empire' and 'Minimal Nation' (both 1994, Tresor/Axis). Also records as Floorplan (gospel-inflected house). Tracked name.

disco zombie.note: LA techno DJ and producer active in the WORK / Dirty Epic underground orbit — dark, groovy techno; co-hosts the @earlyafters show on KCHUNG Radio.

onyx.note: LA-based underground techno DJ, active on the WORK / INCOGNITO circuit; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

rubbermiro.note: LA techno DJ (KCHUNG Radio earlyafters host alongside Disco Zombie) — dark, groovy underground techno; regular on the Dirty Epic / WORK circuit.

jayda g.note: Vancouver-born, London-based producer/DJ Jacinda Gulley — environmental toxicologist turned Grammy-nominated house and disco selector; two albums on Ninja Tune including 'Guy' (2023). An instinctive digger with genuine soul. Tracked name.

enayet.note: NYC-based, Dhaka-raised producer and SLINK co-founder — debut EP 'Chokkor' recorded in Bangladesh; polyrhythmic club music with South Asian vocal/percussion textures; collaborated with Daytimers and Talvin Singh.

k wata.note: NYC producer Kenzo Perron, SLINK co-founder — experimental grooves between warehouse electro, trap and psychedelic reggaeton; produced for Yaeji; contributed to james K 'Friend' remix album.

discostan.note: LA collective/label co-founded by Arshia Fatima Haq and Jeremy Loudenback — archives and decolonizes the dancefloor through South/West Asian and North African music: '80s diaspora disco, folkloric sounds, re-edits and political interventions. Featured in Pitchfork, The Guardian, KCRW.

pocari g.note: LA-based house DJ active on the local underground circuit; limited wider public footprint.

ashtre.note: LA-based selector on the local house/underground circuit; no verified label or broader profile found.

oso disco.note: LA disco/house DJ; included per billing, limited verifiable detail.

blaze claze.note: LA-based DJ; included per billing, no wider verifiable profile found.

halo varga.note: Brian Varga — Chicago-bred selector, one of fabric London's first resident DJs; releases on All Inn Records, Visionquest, Soma, Yoshitoshi; now San Diego-based and co-owner of Artifact Record Shop. Deep Chicago house roots with a European finish.

dylan payne.note: LA-based vinyl selector and Inthebagg label head — all-vinyl sets of house, microhouse and minimal grooves; Sunday Sessions LA regular.

highkin'.note: Moscow-born, LA-based vinyl collector and DJ — active on the LA underground circuit with an RA profile; limited wider public footprint beyond local bookings.

flying mojito bros.note: British duo Ben Chetwood and Jack Sellen — cosmic country-funk and classic rock reimagined as acid house and modern disco; releases on Ubiquity, Paper Recordings, !K7 and Heavenly. Think Crosby Stills and Nash at the Hacienda.

brainstory.note: LA trio (Inland Empire origin) — jazz-inflected neo-soul, psychedelia and hip-hop textures; primarily a live band, not a DJ act. Some groove DNA but a different lane from the dance floor.

ginger root.note: Cameron Lew's solo project from Huntington Beach — immaculately crafted indie soul, alt-disco, boogie and Japanese city pop; primarily a live band but occasionally performs DJ sets. Influences include Vulfpeck, Toro y Moi and Yellow Magic Orchestra.

eli escobar.note: New York house and disco veteran — 20+ years in the scene, Tiki Disco crew founding member, Night People NYC label boss; sets traverse soulful disco, jazzy house, funk, reggaeton and Afrobeat without losing the floor.

charlotte de witte.note: Belgian techno powerhouse, KNTXT label boss — hard, hypnotic peak-time techno; a tracked name and one of the strongest bookings on this lineup.

boys noize.note: Berlin electro/techno veteran (Alex Ridha) — distorted, industrial-leaning club music going back to the mid-2000s Boysnoize Records run; still a reliably weird, high-energy set.

maceo plex.note: Miami-via-Barcelona producer (Eric Estornel) — tech-house and techno crossover, Ellum Audio boss; deep, dark, groove-driven.

tiga.note: Montreal electro-house institution (Turbo Recordings) — tongue-in-cheek, disco-inflected electro; a real name for the older end of this bill.

vtss.note: Polish DJ/producer on the harder, rave-leaning end of techno — Bicep's Fabric label, T4T LUV NRG co-founder; a genuinely respected underground name amid the festival billing.

shygirl.note: UK rapper/vocalist and NUXXE co-founder — hyperpop-adjacent club music, Sega Bodega/Arca collaborator; more art-club than DJ set.

hannah laing.note: Scottish DJ/producer on the UK hard-house/hardcore-revival wave — high-BPM, rave-nostalgic tech house.

vintage culture.note: Brazilian tech-house export, Solotoko boss — tracked name; huge festival draw, big-room but genuinely well-selected house.

mau p.note: Dutch producer of 'Drugs From Amsterdam' fame — tracked name; big-room tech house with a raw, jacking edge.

dj seinfeld.note: Swedish-Argentine producer (Armand Jakobsson) who pioneered 'lo-fi house' — tracked name; hazy, nostalgic house that's a shade more tasteful than most of this bill.

chris lorenzo.note: UK bass/house producer, Half Baked label — tracked name; UK garage-inflected, bass-heavy house.

interplanetary criminal.note: Manchester producer riding the UK bassline/2-step revival — one of the more interesting names on the bill if you like that skippy, rave-adjacent garage sound.

amelie lens.note: Belgian techno star, Exhale label — tracked name; driving, hypnotic peak-time techno with real European club credibility (see also her own Grand Park date this batch).

andy c.note: UK drum & bass legend, RAM Records boss — outside the house/techno lane but a genuine, decades-deep DJ talent if you catch a set.

polo and pan.note: French duo (Paul Armand-Delille & Alexandre Grynszpan) doing lush, tropical-tinged synth-pop and disco touches — a strong, Balearic-adjacent opening act even if the headliner isn't your lane.

knock2.note: US producer straddling bass music and pop-leaning electronic — big festival-stage energy, outside the house/techno lane.

sacha robotti.note: Berlin-schooled, LA-based producer and Slothacid label founder — house/techno with releases on Dirtybird, Defected and Kompakt; his debut album drops on Dirtybird in 2026, so this booking tracks.

gg.note: Resident behind Townhouse Venice's recurring GOOD GAME party — deep house, hip-hop and global rhythms with rotating guest DJs; a westside underground night, not a marquee-name booking.

la riots.note: Daniel Linton's long-running LA tech-house project (started as a duo in 2007) — bloghouse/remix roots (Justice's 'DVNO'), now festival-circuit groove-driven house on Toolroom and Musical Freedom.

doc martin.note: West Coast house pioneer — moved SF to LA in the early '90s, founded the long-running Sublevel label/party (25 years deep in 2026); deep, tribal, acid-inflected house from a genuine scene elder.

lee burridge.note: UK DJ, founder of All Day I Dream — melodic, organic, Balearic-leaning house; about as close to the European sunset-groove reference point as a festival lineup gets.

justin martin.note: Dirtybird co-founder — bouncy, quirky, bass-inflected West Coast house ('Sasquatch', 'Buggin''); SF scene royalty.

radio slave.note: Matt Edwards' techier alias — Rekids co-founder, ex-Ministry of Sound resident; propulsive, muscular house/techno, a genuinely European-pedigreed booking.

mikey lion.note: Desert Hearts co-founder — psychedelic house/techno out of the SoCal camping-rave scene, warmer and trippier than straight club fare.

dj colette.note: Chicago house vocalist/DJ (Om Records, Skint) — classic Chicago-lineage vocal house, been in the game since the late '90s.

anton tumas.note: Subtract Music founder — deep house/techno/hypnotic-electronica selector who ran the beloved 'Subtract On The Pier' Long Beach series; genuinely well-regarded in the SoCal deep-house underground.

davi.note: Armenian-born, LA-based progressive house producer — early support from Hernan Cattaneo, Nick Warren, John Digweed; polished melodic-prog rather than raw underground.

luke mele.note: LA-based selector with a long-running NTS Radio show spanning Balearic house, dub techno, ambient and trip-hop — a genuine home-listening digger, exactly the vinyl-only lane you like.

taylor shockley.note: House/ambient/minimal/dub DJ with credits on Insomniac and Mixcloud — smaller name, limited verifiable bio beyond active gigging.

nick león.note: Miami producer on TraTraTrax and Future Times — fuses dembow, reggaeton and dancehall rhythm into house/techno (his own coined term: 'arquitectronica'); one of the more genuinely distinctive club producers right now, sun-bleached and heavy in equal measure.

demuir.note: Toronto-based, Chicago-schooled house producer — Beatport's #1 Jacking House producer 2015/2016, credited with creating the 'Jackin House' genre tag; 600+ tracks deep, releases on Hot Creations and Classic. Funky, sexy, groove-first house.

massimiliano pagliara.note: Italian-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer with residencies at Berghain/Basement — Chicago house, Italo-disco and electro-disco worked through analog '70s/'80s hardware; a genuine Live at Robert Johnson / Ostgut Ton pedigree, deeply in the European lane.

james axon.note: LA-based DJ (dublab resident, 'Hearing Color') and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love — deep house, dreamy techno, Italo, Balearic and psych-disco; a real musician's ear (former pianist), has played alongside Octo Octa, Eris Drew, Derrick Carter.

drama.note: Chicago R&B/dance duo — producer Na'el Shehade and vocalist Via Rosa — genre-blurring pop/dance/jazz songwriting; played Coachella alongside Frank Ocean and Gorillaz.

gene on earth.note: San Francisco-born, Berlin-based DJ/producer (Eugene Albert) — runs the Limousine Dream label; deep-digging extended sets drifting through minimal house, breaks and hazy late-night rollers.

collin reeve.note: LA house DJ, regular on the Certified Groovers series — limited verifiable bio beyond his own SoundCloud output and repeat bookings on the bill.

pan pot.note: Berlin duo (Tassilo Ippenberger & Thomas Benedix), Second State label bosses — big, weighty, driving techno; a genuine headliner for a 4-hour extended set.

doostah.note: LA house/techno DJ who works marketing for 6AM Group/WORK/Synthetik Minds — one of the promoters playing support, not an outside booking.

kitty logic.note: Hong Kong-born, LA-based DJ and TRANS*CENDENT co-founder who came up in the warehouse scene — driving techno and trance sets, on the harder/faster end of the spectrum.

neek.note: SoCal DJ/producer who's blown up fast in the hard-techno lane through viral edits and heavy, industrial-leaning production.

dea magna.note: LA techno/hard-techno producer, classically trained, releases on Reinier Zonneveld's Filth On Acid — fuses trance intensity with techno drive.

merimell.note: Estonian hard-techno DJ/producer, Machine Nation founder — one of the harder European exports, industrial textures and peak-time intensity.

kayzo.note: LA bass-music DJ who built his name on hardstyle/dubstep/trap crossover and has recently leaned back into hard dance and hard techno — aggressive, riddim-adjacent, not a selector's night.

blksoap.note: DJ, educator, and Soul Source LA co-founder (also runs Textures) — deep, eclectic sets spanning house, beats and '90s R&B/neo-soul; the resident anchoring this monthly.

kobie dozier.note: LA jazz saxophonist out of the Leimert Park scene (studied with Ricky Washington, Kamasi Washington-adjacent lineage) — his billing here points to a live-jazz element in the room, not a straight DJ set.

shanto.note: LA-based DJ/producer ranging downtempo through deep and indie house to techno — a regular on the city's rooftop/deep-house circuit.

young franco.note: Brisbane-raised, Sydney-based producer (Joseph Da Rin de Barbera) — ARIA-certified pop-leaning dance songs ('Drop Your Love,' a Magic Mike's Last Dance cut), Apple/EA/NFL sync placements. Big, sunny, festival-friendly rather than underground; good-time daytime pool set energy.

okayval.note: Colombian-born, US-based rising DJ/producer blending techno and tech house — Beatport/SoundCloud presence but too new for a fuller bio; billed as the headliner here.

silvertone.note: Philadelphia house/techno producer working minimal tech, bass house and acid — early-career, small footprint, but the sound fits a warehouse late-night.

day thief.note: US DJ/producer (Sophie L) working the underground FLINTA*/queer party circuit out of SF/Oakland and NYC — appears on BASEMENT-adjacent bills; leans dark, all-night warehouse techno.

faited.note: Oakland-based DJ (Fait P) from the Envelope Soundsystem/Eris Drew-Octo Octa orbit — underground queer techno and house circuit, more soundsystem-culture than festival-facing.

township rebellion.note: Berlin/Cologne techno-house duo (Stil vor Talent, Suara) — shadowy, vocal-accented melodic techno that helped shape the Lane 8/Afterlife-adjacent sound; broke wider after a 2019 Burning Man set connected them to Rufus Du Sol's camp.

denyc.note: LA-based artist (Denise Poole) blending live vocals with dance-heavy basslines — still emerging, limited track record.

fun2bjane.note: LA DJ (Jane O'Conner) — INCOGNITO and Sensory Signal resident who's played HARD Summer and Skyline; sets bounce between sassy house/techno and late-'90s prog/trance.

etari.note: LA-based (Orange County-raised) producer and AUNTIE co-founder — house through trance and techno, with releases on 100% Silk; regular on the Lights Down Low/HARD Summer circuit.

rosie love.note: LA underground DJ tied to the Apt4B Radio scene — spins house and techno; limited wider public profile beyond local bookings.

mike servito.note: Detroit-bred, NY-based DJ and longtime Bunker NYC resident — jacking, unpretentious sets that move fluidly through house, acid and techno; a fixture of the queer-underground warehouse circuit for two-plus decades.

jason kendig.note: Detroit-vet DJ and one-quarter of San Francisco's Honey Soundsystem crew — deep, eclectic house/techno selection; frequent Servito collaborator (Honcho, The Black Madonna's We Still Believe tour).

apt4b radio.note: LA collective throwing intimate, no-phones-on-the-floor house/techno/UKG parties in apartments, lofts and small venues — community-first, BIPOC/queer-forward lineups over marquee names.

mura masa.note: Guernsey-born producer Alex Crossan — future bass/alt-R&B crossover, Grammy-nominated for his 2017 debut LP; also produces for Ariana Grande and PinkPantheress. This is a DJ set, not the full live production.

zepparella.note: All-female Led Zeppelin tribute band out of San Francisco (formed 2005) — no original material, note-for-note recreations with genuine musicianship.

adam spry.note: Bay Area indie-folk/alt-rock songwriter, likened to The Shins and Fruit Bats — plays warm, nostalgic guitar pop.

the pretty flowers.note: LA indie-rock four-piece led by Noah Green, three albums in (most recent 'Never Felt Bitter' on Forge Again Records, 2026) — hooky, literate underground rock, well-regarded on the local circuit.

markus schulz.note: German-American trance veteran (Coldharbour Recordings founder, longtime top-10 DJ Mag placement) — progressive trance with techno and D&B influences. Well outside the house/techno lane; a big trance name, not a groove/European-house one.

beau didier.note: Amsterdam DJ/producer (b. 1999) and Vulged co-founder — bass-heavy, vocal-driven hard groove/techno; releases on Molekül and Mutual Rytm, plays HÖR Berlin and Awakenings. Making his LA debut here.

ötak.note: Recurring THERMAL support DJ — hard/industrial techno, releases on 44 Label Group and Dolma Records; a known quantity on this specific TBA-warehouse circuit rather than a marquee name.

kyrxmi.note: Phoenix-via-LA techno DJ, EvilGroove label affiliate — deep, driving, hypnotic groove techno; plays the Southern California TBA-warehouse circuit.

kana hishiya.note: Japan-born, LA-based DJ/producer — house and techno moving between punchy, minimal and broken-beat, with dreamy melodic turns; played MEOKO and Sirens LA podcast series.

bilaliwood.note: NYC/LA DJ, ex-child actor — plays tasteful, left-of-center selections across genres; regular on the DāM-Funk/Fusicology TBA-party orbit.

stavroz.note: Belgian four-piece live band — organic, cinematic electronic music blending acoustic textures with emotive melodies (breakout tracks 'The Finishing,' 'Gold Town'); Coachella and Pukkelpop alumni, half a million-plus monthly Spotify listeners. A live act, not a DJ set.

orion 224.note: Houston indie/alt-rock four-piece (formed 2016) fronted by Cristian Gonzalez — melodic guitar-driven indie rock.

cannon the dealers.note: Brownsville, TX 'indie-sleaze' four-piece — nostalgic early-2000s indie rock/shoegaze/hardcore blend, Strokes/Red Pears lineage; touring behind their album 'Still Too Soon.'

dj slugo.note: Chicago ghetto-house/footwork pioneer, founding Dance Mania crew alongside DJ Deeon and Paul Johnson — raw, high-BPM, chant-hook club tracks; the sound Daft Punk sampled on 'Teachers.'

scotty boy.note: Vegas-based house veteran (25+ years, three Billboard Dance #1s) and founder of DTLA's long-running 'Deep House Brunch' — plays crowd-friendly deep/jackin' house and nu-disco edits, more festival-polish than underground digger.

nikki nair.note: Atlanta producer/DJ blending techno, electro, breaks and UK bass into something genre-agnostic and physical — releases on Dirtybird and Lobster Theremin, mentored early by Underground Resistance's Mike Banks.

george daniel.note: The 1975's drummer moonlighting as a dance producer/DJ — founded the label dh2 out of afterparty DJ sets; plays bass-leaning, UK-rap-inflected electronic sets, not a genre veteran but a genuine crate-digger's side project.

embrz.note: Dublin producer (Jack Casey) making atmospheric, vocal-forward melodic house — signed to Lane 8's This Never Happened label; downtempo-leaning and emotive rather than peak-time.

isaac carter.note: London DJ/producer, vocal-led deep house on his own Ochi imprint — championed by Ben UFO, Joy Orbison and Seth Troxler; UK-club lineage (Chicago/Detroit roots filtered through contemporary UK dance).

lubelski.note: LA producer (Jake Lubell) making analog, vinyl-informed house with a wide festival footprint (Lightning in a Bottle, Desert Hearts, Dirtybird Campout) — eclectic and percussive rather than a strict selector.

phantoms.note: LA duo (Kyle Kaplan, Vinnie Pergola) blurring house and indie-dance — 'alternative electronic,' now on Foreign Family, ODESZA's label. Bigger-room, hooky and radio-adjacent rather than a selector's set.

dj rashida.note: Rashida Gonzalez Robinson — spent a decade as Prince's touring/opening DJ and played his private parties; genuinely the person to trust with a Prince set, not a stunt booking.

man man.note: Philadelphia-born experimental rock band led by Honus Honus (Ryan Kattner) — theatrical, maximalist arrangements (sousaphone, marimba, toy noisemakers) somewhere between carnival music and art-punk. Toured with Modest Mouse; now LA-based.

american tomahawk.note: LA indie/alt-rock trio (not the Mike Patton supergroup of the same-ish name) — small local footprint, couldn't verify much beyond the billing.

norwood fisher.note: Fishbone's bassist/co-founder for four decades — funk-punk-metal crossover pioneer; Blackened Sabbath is his project reworking Black Sabbath's catalog through a Black-rock lens with a rotating band of heavy-scene players.

hydeclip.note: Barcelona-rooted producer (releases via 48 Records, AH Digital, Kosà) who folds Latin and Middle Eastern melodic textures into tech-house/progressive sets — a global-groove angle on this bill, not a big name.

felix da housecat.note: Chicago house lifer turned electroclash figurehead — mentored by acid-house originator DJ Pierre in the '80s, ran Radikal Fear Records through the '90s, then broke big with 2001's 'Kittenz and Thee Glitz' (with Miss Kittin), which more or less wrote the electroclash playbook. Deep discography of remixes for Madonna/Britney from that era too.

dj noir.note: LA selector (Phyliss Jaxson) affiliated with Juke Bounce Werk and dublab's radio community — footwork/juke and bass-leaning sets.

boo lean.note: Lauren Goshinski — NYC/LA selector, VIA Festival co-founder, now a Public Records/Lot Radio resident; eclectic, genre-blurring sets moving through dub, drum-play and melodic vocal house.

spiñorita.note: Angela Ramirez — Alhambra-raised Chicana DJ and host of NTS's Casual Play; disco, house, funk and vinyl-digging roots, a fixture of LA's underground/backyard party scene since 2010.

lil texas.note: Texas producer behind 'Texcore' — 200+ BPM gabber/Frenchcore fused with Southern rave theatrics; released on Masters of Hardcore and Barong Family, did the 2021 Gaga/Elton John hardcore remix. Also runs a slower techno alias, Diamond Dallas.

vilena.note: LA-based DJ/producer playing groovy, deep, driving techno with a progressive edge; featured on Spectrum Radio's global techno platform — a solid underground booking, not a marquee name.

jody wisternoff.note: Bristol DJ/producer, one half of veteran duo Way Out West, and a co-curator of Anjunadeep's flagship annual mix series — deep, melodic progressive house that's exactly the Anjuna-adjacent sound this rooftop lane runs on.

vltra it.note: Sicilian tech-house duo (Samuele Giambona & Riccardo Anzalone) — Beatport-chart regulars since 'Zilla' on Lee Foss's Repopulate Mars, collabs with The Martinez Brothers and Loco Dice, now touring Tomorrowland/Elrow-tier stages.

chambord.note: LA-based DJ/production duo — eclectic, melodic sets pulling in world-music textures alongside more hypnotic electronic passages; a reasonable fit for FLOAT's rooftop-groove daytime format.

pegassi.note: Belgian producer (Sam Huybrecht) running his own label/party series Sweet Nothing — a deliberately 'post-genre' set that swings between trance, techno, eurodance and house rather than staying in a lane. Closer to a big-room selector than a groove/disco DJ.

massane.note: French melodic-house producer and guitarist — debut EP and album on Lane 8's This Never Happened, plus a release on mau5trap. Guitar-textured, emotive melodic house that sits right next to the Anjunadeep/Lane 8 end of the spectrum.

maddix.note: Dutch producer known for a hard-hitting techno/big-room/trance crossover (breakout track 'Ecstasy'), Revealed Recordings-affiliated. Mainstage-built and harder-edged than the refined techno end of the lane (Charlotte de Witte, Amelie Lens) — closer to festival trance-techno.

jason bonham.note: John Bonham's son and a drummer in his own right — leads this touring recreation of the Led Zeppelin catalog with full band and visual production. About as legitimate as a non-original-lineup Zeppelin show gets, but it's still a legacy/tribute-format night, not a new act.

beltran.note: Rising tech-house producer known for driving, percussive sets rooted in Brazilian/Latin rhythm and low-end groove — co-signed by FISHER, Chris Lake and Michael Bibi. Squarely the mainstream-but-tasteful tech-house lane.

oguz.note: Dutch-Turkish techno DJ/producer — high-tempo, hard-driving peak-time techno, a regular on the international festival/club circuit. Refined-end-of-techno rather than melodic.
